headline: Channel Tunnel Operator Getlink Reports Increased Traffic Volumes in October
summary: Getlink reported growth across its main transport services for October, led by higher volume in Eurotunnel passenger shuttles and freight traffic.
why: Getlink operates the Channel Tunnel infrastructure and shuttle services connecting the United Kingdom and continental Europe.

impacts.name: Getlink SE
impacts.why: Higher operational traffic volume supports core transport revenue.
